governing_rules: Golden Rule: A capability is implemented only when its code exists, executes, is tested, and is consistent.
Honesty Rule: Zero fabrication of models, datasets, metrics, checkpoints, or split claims.

capabilities.name: Raster Gateway (GeoTIFF Parsing & Metadata Extraction)
capabilities.evidence: tests/test_day1.py::test_raster_inspector_* passes; extracts bounds, CRS, affine transform, nodata, band stats, and auto-detects modality.
capabilities.limitations: Requires valid GeoTIFF format with readable spatial profile; returns structured error on malformed files.

capabilities.name: Spatial & Multimodal Compatibility Checker
capabilities.evidence: tests/test_day1.py::test_compatibility_temporal_pair passes; computes spatial overlap IoU, CRS match, and resolution ratio.
capabilities.limitations: Strict CRS requirement; rejects pairs without reprojection when CRS differs.

capabilities.name: Query Parser & Heuristic Classification
capabilities.model_dependency: None (Explicitly labeled heuristic confidence, not ML probability)
capabilities.evidence: tests/test_day2.py::test_query_parser_classification passes; classifies intent, task type, and extracts target entities.
capabilities.limitations: Rule-based parser; cannot resolve complex syntactic ambiguity outside remote sensing taxonomy.

capabilities.name: Agentic Router & Sensor Separation
capabilities.evidence: tests/test_day2.py::test_sar_pathway_separation passes; prevents SAR data from entering optical pathways.
capabilities.limitations: Routes strictly according to verified raster metadata and sensor physical modality.

capabilities.name: Sufficiency Refusal Gates
capabilities.evidence: tests/test_day2.py::test_missing_input_refusal_demo6 passes; single-image temporal request honestly refused with missing input explanation.
capabilities.limitations: Hard refusal gate; requires minimum 2 co-registered rasters for temporal queries and paired optical+SAR for fusion queries.

capabilities.name: Factual Execution Trace Engine
capabilities.evidence: tests/test_day2_consistency.py::test_sar_scheduled_vs_executed passes; strictly distinguishes SCHEDULED from EXECUTED events.
capabilities.limitations: Records post-execution facts only; never marks unexecuted tools as executed.

capabilities.name: Deterministic SAR Analysis Engine
capabilities.evidence: tests/test_day3_sar.py (13 tests) and tests/test_scientific_contracts.py pass; Lee speckle filter operates in linear power domain; Otsu water detector bounded by [-24 dB, -12 dB].
capabilities.limitations: Requires valid dual-pol VV/VH SAR bands; water threshold is scene-dependent heuristic, not universal.

capabilities.name: Deterministic Optical Spectral Engine
capabilities.evidence: tests/test_day3_optical.py (10 tests) and tests/test_scientific_contracts.py pass; verifies NDVI, NDWI, MNDWI, zero-denominator guards, and rule-based heuristic classifier.
capabilities.limitations: Band mapping requires explicit wavelength metadata; refuses ambiguous band sets without guessing.

capabilities.name: Remote Sensing Foundation Model Preflight (GeoChat)
capabilities.evidence: tests/test_day2_consistency.py::test_geochat_preflight_does_not_claim_real_inference passes; detects CPU-only host and routes to deterministic fallback.
capabilities.limitations: Cannot run 7B model locally on CPU. VRAM requirement is configuration-dependent. The exact requirement must be measured for the selected model, quantization, image resolution, context length, batch size, gradient accumulation, and checkpointing configuration.

capabilities.name: BigEarthNet.txt Multimodal Dataset Subsystem
capabilities.dataset_dependency: BigEarthNet.txt (Parquet metadata: 466.8 MB, 9.55M records, 464K patch pairs)
capabilities.evidence: tests/test_day4_dataset.py and tests/test_day4_real_datasets.py pass; verified disjoint official splits and zero cross-split leakage.
capabilities.limitations: Full 350+ GB raw image archives are BLOCKED_STORAGE on host drive C: (106.6 GB free); dev patch pairs and complete text/metadata are present.

capabilities.name: RS-VLM LoRA Adaptation Pipeline
capabilities.model_dependency: Configured for HuggingFace Transformers & PEFT LoRA (rank 16, alpha 32)
capabilities.evidence: tests/test_day4_adaptation.py (8 tests) pass; hardware preflight verifies CPU host and halts without generating fake weights or fake loss curves.
capabilities.limitations: Actual model optimization has NOT been executed locally (training_status: NOT_EXECUTED). Remote NVIDIA GPU required.

capabilities.name: Public Benchmark Governance (VRSBench & CDVQA)
capabilities.dataset_dependency: VRSBench (62,918 eval annotations) & CDVQA (122,797 QA pairs)
capabilities.evidence: tests/test_day4_real_datasets.py passes; enforces training_allowed=false for VRSBench; normalizes grounding coordinates between [0, 100] tokens and normalized float.
capabilities.limitations: Evaluation data only; evaluation has not been executed yet pending trained model checkpoint.

capabilities.name: Temporal Change Detection Engine (Day 5 Scope)
capabilities.evidence: Day 2 router and API explicitly reject or refuse temporal execution until Day 5 implementation.
capabilities.limitations: Reserved for Day 5 implementation. DO NOT IMPLEMENT in Day 1-4 audit.

capabilities.name: Optical-SAR Deep Fusion Engine (Day 5 Scope)
capabilities.evidence: Day 2 router routes to fusion branch with execution_status=NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
capabilities.limitations: Reserved for Day 5 implementation. DO NOT IMPLEMENT in Day 1-4 audit.
